entities.summary: Zee Café also known as Z Café is an Indian pay television channel owned by Zee Entertainment Enterprises. The channel mainly syndicates popular American and British television shows to appeal to the English-speaking population of India. Since April 1, 2026, the channel has been broadcasting popular sports tournaments in Hindi and is set to rebrand under the Zee Sports portfolio.
